source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES can attempt an exact named read but does not establish the standby rail/controller boundary, AC/DC/host/BMC state, units/scaling, state-conditioned zero/unavailable rules or full UI parity; its fallback is truncated and credential-unsafe.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires standby-domain and current-state definitions and forbids changing power. V3.1 further distinguishes this point from HSC1-10 and binds acceptance to the always-on consumer boundary and exact state-matrix row.

old_problem: A readable exact-name value is not enough: standby power can remain active with host DC off, or legitimately be zero/unavailable in another architecture/state. Without the controller/rail/consumer boundary and recorded AC, PSU, host, BMC and HSC enable state, one universal expected value could create a false PASS or prompt an unsafe power transition.
disposition_reason: Bind PWR_STBY_HSC to its Project standby controller, rail and always-on consumer boundary and evaluate it only for the current recorded power-state matrix row. Use complete protected read-only OOB and both UI views; do not force standby or import GPU load from the separate dynamic case. Missing topology or state rules makes execution NOT READY, not engineering-review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 901, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, preceding HSC1-10 and separate dynamic history, and the preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.
Unlike range cases, the exact sensor name is a valid read candidate after inventory confirmation, but it cannot itself prove the measured boundary or applicable state-specific expectation.
Standby power is architecture- and state-dependent and may sustain BMC/recovery logic; changing AC/DC/host state solely for this row could remove the management path.
ED-06 and ED-18 keep power states/transitions distinct, ED-15 forbids PASS without the matching state criterion, ED-17 preserves logs and ED-20 separates STBY_HSC from HSC1-10.

test_case.test_name: Verify PWR_STBY_HSC for the recorded AC/DC/host/BMC state without changing power
test_case.purpose: Verify the single PWR_STBY_HSC record maps to the approved standby controller/rail and always-on consumer domain and correctly shows its quantity, units, value, health, supported thresholds and freshness in Dashboard and Server Health for the explicitly recorded current platform power state.
required_package: Chassis/baseboard/PSU/BMC/BIOS identity and authoritative STBY_HSC definition distinct from HSC1-10
Standby power-tree boundary, upstream source, HSC controller designator/PN/revision and always-on downstream consumer map
Current AC presence, PSU/feed/redundancy, host/DC state such as S0/S5/G3, BMC state and HSC enable/fault state
Controller bus/address/channel/register, measured quantity/units, scaling, calibration, averaging/sample window and update interval
Stable SDR/API/Dashboard/Server Health identity plus the approved state-matrix range, tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, zero/unavailable/stale rules
Validated protected read-only BMC/browser client and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL, BMC, power or host logs and do not change AC/DC/host power, PSU feeds, standby/main rails, HSC enablement, board/GPU load, fan control, thresholds or firmware. Record the complete present-state tuple and select the matching approved acceptance row; if the required state differs, stop rather than transition. Confirm the exact SDR/API identity, review the Script, then read PWR_STBY_HSC through protected read-only access with full metadata and capture the same Dashboard and Server Health point. Correlate controller/rail, quantity/units, value, supported thresholds, health, sample window and timestamps with the state-specific rule. Stop without retry on stale, lost or divergent telemetry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact OOB record and both UI views map to the same approved standby controller/rail/consumer domain and agree on quantity, units, value, health, supported thresholds and freshness. The result satisfies the Project rule for the recorded AC/PSU/host/BMC/HSC state, including documented zero or unavailable behavior where applicable; HSC1-10 or a different state does not substitute.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative standby topology, an exact recorded state tuple, the corresponding approved criterion and complete correlated OOB/two-UI evidence with engineer acceptance. A readable value, generic limit, truncated fallback, copied numbered-HSC result or data from another power state cannot pass. Wrong controller/rail/unit/scaling, out-of-state-rule value, stale data or required UI/status/threshold mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology/state-matrix/acceptance or reviewed access is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS. One passive state does not cover transitions, inrush, trip/recovery or GPU-load coupling.
safety_gate: Preserve SEL, BMC, power and host history; do not perform the generic clear-log step.
Record the present power state and do not force S0/S5/G3, AC/DC or PSU-feed changes to obtain a reading.
Do not infer STBY_HSC is HSC1-10 or identify consumers from the label; require the Project power tree.
Do not import GPU/module load, alter HSC enablement, standby/main rails, fans, thresholds or firmware.
Use secret-safe supported transport and full output; do not expose credentials, assume cipher 17, run an unreviewed Script or automatically retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/baseboard/PSU/BMC identity and approved STBY_HSC controller/rail/upstream/always-on-consumer map
Recorded AC presence, PSU/feed redundancy, host/DC, BMC and HSC enable/fault state with exact acceptance-matrix row
Controller channel/register, quantity/units, scaling/calibration/window and stable SDR/API/UI identity
Full raw value, supported thresholds, health and synchronized timestamp plus matching Dashboard and Server Health visual fields
State-specific comparison including zero/unavailable/stale interpretation and explicit untested-state/transition coverage
Protected Script/client provenance, no-clear/no-load-or-power-transition-or-write/no-retry proof, final management health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No state change is authorized. If the current state lacks an approved rule, the sensor is stale/lost, or BMC/power health changes, stop and preserve all logs and the exact state tuple; do not power-cycle or alter feeds to recover evidence. Use only approved read-only diagnosis. Any later power transition requires separate authorization, OFF/ON/OS-ready criteria where applicable and its own recovery plan.

source_conflict.reason: This passive row consistently requests PWR_STBY_HSC display/spec validation and does not contain the GPU-stress mismatch found in another source case. Missing rail and state details are readiness inputs.

blocked.reason: The single passive state-conditioned objective is clear. Project power-tree and state-matrix inputs can make it executable without a power transition.
